annotations.title: Tracked GTA 6 markets and price status

description: Use this when someone asks which countries GTA 6 prices are tracked for, or which prices are confirmed. Lists every tracked market (101 today) with the price status of each; prices were last fully rechecked on November 4, 2026. Optional filter by status.

status.description: Only markets with this price status: confirmed (read from the local store), reported (a named outlet reported it), estimate (not yet confirmed), usd (the store bills in US dollars), unlisted (the local store exists and does not list GTA 6), none (no local store). Leave out for every market.
